notes:
{作物|さくもつ} refers to plants cultivated by humans for food, fiber, or other uses. It covers all types of crops including grains, vegetables, and fruits.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{農作物|のうさくもつ}→農作物：noentry⟧: agricultural products/crops
- {作物|さくもつ}⟦{栽培|さいばい}→栽培：13108_saibai⟧: crop cultivation
- ⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧{作物|さくもつ}: main/staple crops
- ⟦{畑作物|はたさくもつ}→畑作物：noentry⟧: dry-field crops (as opposed to rice paddy crops)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {作物|さくもつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to grow crops
- {作物|さくもつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}る→実る：00282_minoru⟧: the crops bear fruit
- {作物|さくもつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to harvest crops
- {作物|さくもつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: crops suffer damage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{穀物|こくもつ}→穀物：02806_kokumotsu⟧: grains specifically (rice, wheat, corn)
- ⟦{農産物|のうさんぶつ}→農産物：14360_nousanbutsu⟧: agricultural products (broader, includes processed goods)
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧: vegetables (one type of crop)
